## About

Raghav Dinesh (handle: ruwgxo) is a Detection & Security Platform Engineer who has been building security intelligence infrastructure since 2012. Based in Bengaluru, India.

- GitHub: https://github.com/ruwgxo
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/ruwgxo

## Technical Profile

**Languages**: Python (primary), Go (secondary), SQL, Bash

**Cloud**: AWS, Azure, GCP, IBM Cloud

## Current Work

Security Engineer at IBM (Bengaluru) since 2021, working on the systems that connect security data to decisions: detection rules, telemetry pipelines, and continuous visibility into cloud infrastructure.

## Books

### AI Security Mastery
**URL**: https://ruwgxo.com/book
**Source**: https://github.com/ruwgxo/ai-security-mastery
**Status**: v1.1 complete; v2.0 in progress
**Description**: From ML Fundamentals to Production Detection Systems. 18 chapters, 270 sections. Covers ML and deep learning foundations, LLM architecture, prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, model extraction, adversarial machine learning, and detection engineering through production deployment. Free and open source under the MIT licence.

**Chapters**:
1. Machine Learning Fundamentals
2. Deep Learning Basics
3. LLM Architecture
4. Modern LLM Internals
5. AI Threat Landscape
6. Prompt Injection Attacks
7. Jailbreak Techniques
8. Training Data Poisoning
9. Model Extraction & Stealing
10. Adversarial Machine Learning
11. Detection Framework Design
12. ML-Based Detection Systems
13. Behavioral Analysis & Monitoring
14. Production Deployment
15. Building Production Detectors
16. SIEM Integration
17. Monitoring & Tuning
18. Real-World Case Studies

### Detection Engineering at Scale
**Source**: https://github.com/ruwgxo/detection-engineering-at-scale
**Status**: In progress. Chapter 5 (AI security detection, ten sections) is published; 15 chapters are planned.
**Description**: A SIEM-agnostic field guide to detection platforms, using OCSF and Sigma throughout.

### Scaling Giants
**Source**: https://github.com/ruwgxo/scaling-giants
**Status**: Being rewritten from primary sources.
**Description**: Architecture case studies of large-scale systems, each built on the papers and engineering posts of the companies that built them.

### OSINT
**Source**: https://github.com/ruwgxo/osint
**Status**: Being rewritten.
**Description**: Open source intelligence methodology: collection, analysis, tradecraft, and dissemination.

## Open Source Projects

- **hsed** — Unix chmod-inspired permission model for cryptographic operations, with policy generation for AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault and GCP Cloud KMS. Published on PyPI. (https://github.com/ruwgxo/hsed)
- **aegis** — Experimental hybrid classical and post-quantum encryption (ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-87). Pre-alpha, not production-ready. (https://github.com/ruwgxo/aegis)
- **living-threat-intel** — Threat intelligence pipeline: collectors for CISA KEV, NVD, AlienVault OTX and URLhaus, deduplication, and Sigma/YARA rule generation for review. (https://github.com/ruwgxo/living-threat-intel)
- **cyber-loss-mcp** — Read-only MCP server for sourced cyber-incident loss figures. Design phase. (https://github.com/ruwgxo/cyber-loss-mcp)
